about.heroSubtitle: PRIMA Institute is an innovative learning organization providing tailored vocational training solutions to corporate, government and individual clients.
about.missionPara1: PRIMA Institute is an innovative learning organization providing tailored vocational training solutions to corporate, government and individual clients. Our trainings mainly focus on 4 categories: Hotel & Tourism, Garment Making & Fashion Design, Computer Technology, and Beauty & Hair Dressing.
about.missionPara2: Since its inception in 2018 GC, PRIMA has trained a large number of individuals, served business customers, and advanced the skills and careers of many professionals through hands-on, expert-led trainings.
about.missionPara3: This passion is a driving force in all we do, from our expert-led courses, to our ground-breaking employee training and development program. Experience our passion for yourself.
about.locationDesc: Headquartered in Addis Ababa, PRIMA operates a full service training center in Bole Sub-city, Gerji Roba area, Seada Bldg. 3rd floor. Private training can be delivered at client locations and Live Online Training will be available soon via the World Wide Web.
about.locationOnline: Live Online Training Will Be Available Soon
about.value1Desc: PRIMA's advantage is consistent top-quality training. Our Instructors average over 6 years of experience in the subjects they teach, graduated from reputed academic institutions with Masters or Bachelor Degrees.
about.value2Desc: Our instructors are vendor authorized and certified to train, and maintain industry-leading client feedback scores — ensuring every session delivers real value.
about.value3Desc: We provide customized training solutions for corporate, government and individual clients, adapting our programmes to meet specific industry and organizational needs.
about.value4Desc: Our training approach is built on practical, hands-on experience. We believe real skills are built through doing, guided by professionals who are active in their fields.
about.milestone1: PRIMA Institute founded in Addis Ababa, offering Hotel & Tourism vocational training.
about.milestone2: Expanded training offerings to include Garment Making & Fashion Design programmes.
about.milestone3: Computer Technology division launched, completing our three core training categories.
about.milestone4: Grew corporate and government client base, delivering tailored on-site training solutions.
about.milestone5: Trained a large number of individuals and professionals across all three disciplines.
about.milestone6: Live Online Training programme announced — expanding access across Ethiopia and beyond.
about.milestone7: Launched the Beauty & Hair Dressing discipline, offering professional training in hair styling, braiding, and salon management.
